description: In Loop 24, research/loop24/dataset_manifest.json registered exactly 30 documents (102 critical fields) designated as COHORT_I_DEV (8), COHORT_I_CAL (8), COHORT_I_BLIND (10), and COHORT_I_ADV (4). In Loop 23, 6 documents (18 fields) were created for micro-font and narrow gutters (COHORT_H_01 through _06). When the unified 791-field benchmark was compiled in Loop 27 (research/loop27/results/benchmark_results.json), the 6 COHORT_H documents were grouped with the 30 COHORT_I documents under the single benchmark partition 'Cohort_I_Blind'. Total documents = 30 + 6 = 36 documents. Total fields = 102 + 18 = 120 fields. Earlier documentation citing '30 documents, 120 fields' mistakenly cited the 30 document count of the Loop 24 manifest alongside the 120 combined field count of the 36-document combined partition.
